rules.statement: A warrant of attorney to confess judgment must be strictly construed and can only be used by the person or their heirs, executors, administrators, or assigns as specified in the warrant.
rules.supporting_quote: "As has been frequently laid down, these warrants of attorney must be strictly construed. Power to confess judgment is confined to an action by Supramaniam Chetty or his heirs, executors, administrators or assigns."
